policy: Tolerances are declared before execution. Geometry cases use an explicit clipped viewport to exclude platform scrollbar decoration and allow only sparse edge differences. Text and SVG allow rasterizer antialiasing differences; layout or missing content must be investigated, never hidden by increasing these limits.

cases.scope: Fixed block geometry, padding, borders, backgrounds, rounded corners and linear gradient
Flex spacing/alignment and explicit grid tracks/gaps, with no font-dependent geometry
Pinned local Noto Sans, line breaking, line height, inline emphasis and overflow clipping
Local SVG image and basic inline SVG paths/shapes at explicit dimensions
